notes: «يبلغ به النبي» is the transmitter's phrase reaching the Prophet, who is the end and not a link

«وابن طاوس عن أبيه» names a different transmitter for the saying after «بمثله غير أنه قال» (different wording): a variant group, its opening sharing no head with the first route; «أبيه» is a bare relation
